title: 第8幕1300分的高手第9幕蓝蝶的秘密
content_zh:
第8幕 1300分的高手？
出现在邢辰面前的敌人是三个青年一个老头以及一个女人，不过让邢辰颇为奇怪的是那一队人之中似乎是以女人为首，一般来说Dota这种游戏应该更受男人欢迎才对的，女性玩的比较少，能够出头的就更少了。
不过一想到主神选人应该是随机挑选邢辰也就无所谓了，既然这些人被挑选进入了这个所谓的天神游戏，那么即便他们不喜欢Dota也必须去接受，玩得多了女人也不见得会比男人差，有女性资深者根本不足为奇。
果然，暗痕看见了那些人之后立刻凑了上去和那个女人聊了起来，显然这个女人也是一个和暗痕一样的资深者。
“哟，蓝蝶老太婆荷包里面没钱了么？怎么也想到来赚这小孩子的零花钱了？对你来说区区50金币应该不算什么的吧？”暗痕首先开口道。
“50金币的确不算什么，不过输掉的才是50金币，赢的可是能拿100金哟！而这一次么，拿50金的人是你，我可是要拿100的！”
漂亮女人嫣然一笑，仿佛已经认定自己会赢了一般。
“看来蓝蝶老太婆你这一次是志在必得啊，怎么？运气不错？”
暗痕丝毫不惧的笑了起来，因为这一次他自认为自己的运气也相当不错，4个新人居然全部玩过，这种比例已经是相当难得的好运气了。
蓝蝶得意的一笑：“这一次我们这里可是有个1300的狠角色哟！你还是小心一点吧！”
“1300！？”
暗痕暗道一声不好，之前得意的脸色也瞬间变得铁青起来。
所谓1300指的是现实世界中Dota－X游戏对玩家实力的一种评测，分值越高实力则越强。
按照Dota－X的分值划分，从来没碰过电子产品，让他双击“我的电脑”会抓起鼠标对着电脑机箱狠砸两下的史前巨坑能力值为0（其实这种人根本就不可能会注册账号才对）。
那些第一次碰Dota，满野区打怪找宝箱，满泉水晃悠接任务的RPG玩家一般都有点底子，只要弄清楚一些基本问题一般都可以升到500分以上。
稍微玩过一阵子，但是对英雄技能都不太清楚的菜鸟基本上徘徊在1000分左右，是左是右就要看天赋了。
算起来1300的数值在Dota－X路人选手里面实在是不值一提的水准，随便找个大点的网吧随时都能揪出几十个来，属于那种刚刚脱离初学者范围的菜鸟级玩家。
按理说遇到这种水平的队友并非是一件多么值得兴奋的事情，尤其还是关乎性命的试炼之战，至少邢辰在路人战遇到这类玩家一向都是把他们当空气的，要知道，一局也没打过的新号初始积分就有1200。
不过由于天神游戏貌似是随机从人群中抽取玩家的，这些年Dota虽然流行，但和天朝众多的人口基数一比那也就没啥了，所以一般而言能够遇到玩过Dota的人都能让暗痕他们这些资深者欣喜不已的了，遇到1300分这种“高手”那更是好到足以去买彩票的幸运了！往往几十次也碰不上一个。
如今有如此“高手”撑腰倒也难怪那个女人会如此笃信自己的胜利。

看到暗痕一脸的愁容，蓝蝶不禁得意的哈哈大笑起来，仿佛已经拿到了胜利一般，然后便转身回去指点自己的队员选英雄了，再懒得看邢辰他们这边一眼。
阴郁的盯着蓝蝶看了好半天，暗痕终于憋出了一句“狗屎！”然后转身回到了邢辰他们这里，面色不善的冷声问道：“你们几个Dota－X的分数都是多少？”
“分数？什么分数？我只是在寝室和舍友打过。”
“分数啊，我在网上玩过两次，多少分忘记了，大概有600吧，人家都夸我是天才呢！”
听到两人的回答暗痕已经绝望了，这种货色根本拉不出去啊！Dota－X一局不打初始分也有1200好不好！而在此时，邢辰冷淡的声音仿却佛圣歌一般拯救了他。
“1600。”
当然，邢辰是有所隐瞒的，事实上他也不知道自己到底应该算是多少分的实力——之前的时间大都用来陪老婆了，Dota没怎么冲分，据他自己估测怎么也得有个1800最低。
“1600！？你是说1600！？”
暗痕看向邢辰的眼睛猛然一亮，虽然天神游戏和Dota是有不小区别的，可是现实世界Dota－X的分数很大程度上还是能代表实力高低的，毕竟天神游戏也是以Dota为基础。
能够拿到1600分以上的玩家在他们这些天神玩家中虽然并不少见，生死攸关的事情但凡被选入的玩家都是疯狂磨练自己的技术，除了极少数光靠抱大腿活过来没有任何天赋的幸运儿之外，剩余的基本都有1500以上的水准，没有1800的分数算不上中产阶级，不过2400就和高端阶层没缘，而据说那些站在金字塔顶端的资深者水准都是3000以上甚至超过4000的传奇人物！
可是那是资深者，在这些新人里面邢辰这种级别的玩家简直就是沙子中的钻石一般的存在了！
“很好，那么这一次就全靠你了！好好努力吧！”暗痕大笑起来，猛烈的拍打着邢辰的肩膀，自觉100金币已经到手的暗痕此时已经开始考虑晚上上哪里去欢乐了。
这100金币看似不多，可如果用在现实中的话那也是可以干相当多事情的，多到足以让一国之顶级富豪也为之疯狂的程度。
被拍得肩膀几乎失去知觉的邢辰有些奇怪暗痕刚刚的话，于是开口问道：“你刚刚喊那个女的叫老太婆，你们之间关系很差么？明明是个美女的。而且我记得你说过同俱乐部之间的人关系一般不会太差吧。”
“美女！？她！？”暗痕仿佛听到了什么天大的笑话一般，一脸不可思议的盯着邢辰看了好几秒，然后才大笑着说道：“别开玩笑了！你以为我是因为讨厌她才喊她老太婆的么？我说她老太婆可是一点没错的大实话啊，你别看她现在这个样子，那家伙被选为玩家的时候可是一个已经74岁的老太婆了！”
content_en:
Act 8 A master with 1300 points?
The enemies that appeared in front of Xing Chen were three young men, an old man, and a woman. However, what made Xing Chen quite strange was that the group seemed to be headed by a woman. Generally speaking, games like Dota should be more popular with men. Women play less, and even fewer can stand out.
But it doesn't matter when I think that the main god's selection should be Xing Chen at random. Since these people have been selected to enter this so-called god game, even if they don't like Dota, they have to accept it. Women who play more games are not necessarily inferior to men. It is not surprising that there are female senior players.
Sure enough, after Anhen saw those people, he immediately went up and chatted with the woman. Obviously, this woman was also a senior person like Anhen.
"Hey, does the old lady Lan Die have no money in her purse? Why did you think of earning this kid's pocket money? For you, a mere 50 gold coins shouldn't be anything, right?" An Hen said first.
"50 gold coins is indeed nothing, but the loser only gets 50 gold coins, and the winner gets 100 gold coins! And this time, you are the one who gets 50 gold coins, but I want to get 100!"
The beautiful woman smiled brightly, as if she was sure she would win.
"It seems that old lady Lan Die, you are determined to win this time. What? Are you lucky?"
An Hen laughed without fear, because this time he thought that his luck was quite good. All four newcomers had played the game. This ratio was already quite rare and good luck.
Lan Die smiled proudly: "This time we have a 1300 ruthless character here! You'd better be careful!"
"1300!?"
An Hen secretly said something bad, and his previously proud face instantly turned livid.
The so-called 1300 refers to an evaluation of player strength in the real-world Dota-X game. The higher the score, the stronger the strength.
According to Dota-X's score classification, if he has never touched electronic products, if he double-clicks "My Computer", he will grab the mouse and smash the computer case twice. The prehistoric pit ability value is 0 (in fact, it is impossible for such a person to register an account).
Those RPG players who are playing Dota for the first time, fighting monsters in the jungle to find treasure chests, and wandering around in springs to take on tasks generally have some basic knowledge. As long as they figure out some basic questions, they can usually rise to more than 500 points.
Rookies who have played for a while but don't know much about hero skills are basically hovering around 1000 points. Whether it is left or right depends on talent.
In total, the value of 1300 is really not worth mentioning among Dota-X passersby players. You can find dozens of them at any time in any larger Internet cafe. They are the kind of rookie players who have just left the beginner range.
It stands to reason that meeting teammates of this level is not something worth getting excited about, especially in a trial battle where life is at stake. At least when Xing Chen encounters such players in pub battles, he always treats them as nothing. You know, a new account that has never played a game has an initial score of 1,200.
However, since Tianshen Games seems to randomly select players from the crowd, although Dota has been popular in recent years, it is nothing compared to the large population base of China. Therefore, generally speaking, being able to meet people who have played Dota makes veterans like Anhen extremely happy. Meeting a "master" like 1300 points is good enough to buy lottery tickets! Often dozens of times without encountering one.
Now that there is such a "master" backing her, it's no wonder that the woman is so convinced of her victory.
Seeing the sad look on An Hen's face, Landie couldn't help laughing proudly, as if he had won the victory, and then turned back to instruct his team members to choose heroes., too lazy to look at Xing Chen and the others.
After staring at Landie gloomily for a long time, An Hen finally choked out "Shit!" and then turned back to Xing Chen and the others, and asked in a cold voice with an unkind expression: "What are your scores in Dota-X?"
"Score? What score? I just played with my roommates in the dormitory."
"Scores. I've played twice online. I forgot the score. It's about 600. People say I'm a genius!"
Hearing the answers from the two men, An Hen was already in despair. There was no way he could get this kind of thing out! Dota-X has 1,200 points per game even if you don’t use the initial score! But at this moment, Xing Chen's cold voice saved him like a hymn.
"1600."
Of course, Xing Chen was hiding something. In fact, he didn't know what level of strength he should be considered - he had spent most of his time with his wife before, and he didn't score much in Dota. According to his own estimation, he must have a minimum of 1800.
"1600!? You mean 1600!?"
An Hen's eyes suddenly lit up when he looked at Xing Chen. Although there is a big difference between the Tianshen game and Dota, the score of Dota-X in the real world can still represent the level of strength to a large extent. After all, the Tianshen game is also based on Dota.
Although players who can score more than 1,600 points are not uncommon among these god players, the matters of life and death are all players who are selected to hone their skills like crazy. Except for a few lucky ones who survive by hugging their thighs without any talent, the rest Basically all of them have a level of 1500 or above. A score of 1800 or less is not considered middle class, but a score of 2400 is out of reach for the high-end class. It is said that the senior people who stand at the top of the pyramid are legendary figures with scores above 3000 or even 4000!
But those are senior players. Among these newcomers, players of Xing Chen's level are like diamonds in the sand!
"Very good, then it's all up to you this time! Work hard!" An Hen laughed and slapped Xing Chen's shoulder violently. An Hen, who felt that he had obtained 100 gold coins, was already thinking about where to go to have fun at night.
This 100 gold coins may not seem like much, but if used in reality, it can do a lot of things, enough to make even the top richest people in a country go crazy.
Xing Chen, who was almost unconscious after being patted on the shoulder, was a little surprised by what Anhen said just now, so he asked: "You just called that woman an old woman. Do you have a bad relationship with her? She is obviously a beauty. And I remember you said that the relationship between you and the people in the club is generally not too bad."
"Beauty!? Her!?" An Hen stared at Xing Chen in disbelief for several seconds as if he heard some big joke, and then laughed and said: "Stop joking! Do you think I called her an old woman because I hate her? I said she is an old woman, and it is absolutely true. Don't look at her now. When that guy was selected as a player, she was already a 74-year-old old woman!"
